name: Chigasaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chigasaki city emblem in maroon: a ring crossed by horizontal strokes with a pointed fly, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Chigasaki, a city in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1957.

features.role: Chigasaki city emblem — a ring crossed by horizontal strokes with a pointed fly, like a stylised character
